name: datasette-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Datasette, a tool for exploring and publishing SQLite databases: it
serves databases as a website and a JSON/CSV API with table filters, sorting, facets and full-text
search, runs custom and stored SQL queries, offers a JSON write API, and has settings, configuration
and metadata files, actors, permissions and API tokens, plugin hooks and a Python internals API.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the Datasette application package: every Python module under datasette/ other than the datasette/publish/ deployment commands, together with README.md, the documentation pages docs/json_api.rst, docs/csv_export.rst, docs/binary_data.rst, docs/facets.rst, docs/full_text_search.rst, docs/sql_queries.rst, docs/settings.rst, docs/configuration.rst, docs/metadata.rst, docs/authentication.rst, docs/internals.rst, docs/plugin_hooks.rst, docs/pages.rst and docs/introspection.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
